deleteButtonBlockTip: This cannot be undone: the button block is removed from the document.
deleteButtonBlockFailed: The delete failed; see the console
deleteTopBarButtonTip: This cannot be undone: the quick action disappears from the menu and its JSON file is deleted.
deleteTopBarButtonFailed: The delete failed; see the console
actionContentRequired: Fill in the link address or the JavaScript code
linkAddressTip: Supports http(s), siyuan://blocks/<block ID>, assets/<asset path>, mailto: and other protocols registered on the system; it opens like a link inside a document.
scriptCodeTip: Runs when the button is clicked; return and await are supported, and console output shows up in the result dialog.
scriptFileTip: A local script lives under data/assets/ or data/storage/petal/button-in-siyuan/scripts/, written as a path from the workspace root and read again on every click; an http(s) address is downloaded again on every click.
scriptFileInvalidName: Invalid file name: it cannot contain ~ [ ] ( ) ! ` & { } = # % $ ; ' / \ : * ? " < > |, or exceed 180 bytes
scriptFileExists: A file with that name already exists at the target location
scriptFileNeeded: Pick a .js file under data/assets/ or the plugin's scripts/ directory first
scriptFileFailed: The file operation failed; see the console
cloudWarningTitle: Loading JavaScript from the web may be unsafe
cloudWarningTip: This code comes from the web and may be changed without your knowledge, while a click on the button may read and write your notes. You can give up, or download it into data/assets/ first — after that the button has nothing to do with the web file.
cloudDownloadFailed: The download failed; check that the address is reachable
scriptDocsFailed: The documentation cannot be opened right now
commandTip: Pick a command from the SiYuan command panel. If it no longer exists or cannot run here, clicking the button shows a message.
commandUnavailable: That command is not available right now
scriptUnavailable: This button block cannot run in the current environment; the JavaScript was not run
settingsOutputModeTip: When the result dialog opens after a script runs; the default "With output" opens it only for console output, a return value or an error.
settingsDebugModeTip: Off by default: turns on the plugin's own logs (loading, dialogs, failures) and the script's console.debug output, in the SiYuan console and in the result dialog; off means the plugin prints nothing
settingsCodeWrapTip: When enabled, content wider than the editor wraps automatically; the default "Follow SiYuan" follows SiYuan's "Code block wraps" setting
settingsCodeLigaturesTip: When enabled, the editor shows ligatures (the code font has to bring them); the default "Follow SiYuan" follows SiYuan's "Code block ligature" setting
settingsAgentSkill: Provide the button block skill to the agent
settingsAgentSkillTip: Writes a skill explaining button blocks (payload format, icon list, script APIs) into the workspace skill directory for SiYuan's agent; switching it off deletes that skill
settingsSafeModeTip: In the app, hide the full-screen window below before opening the button editor from a manager or the JavaScript file page from the editor, which works around the app freezing and reloading its frontend. Stored on this device only, never synced, off by default
settingsDownloadSkillTip: Saves the whole skill (SKILL.md and its references) as a zip file, to hand it to another agent
downloadSkillFailed: The download failed, see the console
settingsSaveFailed: The settings could not be saved, please retry
manageButtonBlocksTip: Lists every button block in the workspace in a separate window; search by text, address or script path, preview one and edit it in place
managerSearchPlaceholder: Search text, links, script paths or documents
managerSelectHint: Pick a button block on the left to preview it
managerLoadFailed: Reading the button blocks failed; see the console
topBarManagerTip: Each quick action is one JSON file under data/storage/petal/button-in-siyuan/topbar/, ordered by file name; actions work like button blocks, and only the text, the icon and the action can be edited — the colour is fixed.
topBarManagerEmpty: No quick action yet: use the new icon in the corner, or drop a JSON file into that directory
topBarSaveFailed: The save failed; see the console
topBarLoadFailed: Reading the quick actions failed; see the console
blockNotEditable: The button block cannot be edited right now
readonlyPreviewTip: This note is locked and cannot be edited
discardChangesTip: Closing now leaves the button block as it is; this edit is lost.
topBarDiscardChangesTip: Closing now leaves the quick action file as it is; this edit is lost.
